explanation_short: XGBoost showed strong performance with an R2 of 0.7495 and a correlation of 0.8750. Its MAE was 0.0956, indicating good predictive accuracy.
explanation_full: The XGBoost model demonstrated strong predictive performance, evidenced by an R2 score of 0.7495 and a high correlation of 0.8750 between predicted and actual values. The Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was calculated at 0.0956, suggesting that the average prediction error is low. These metrics confirm that XGBoost is a strong performer on this dataset. The analysis is based on 40 samples, and the linear fit slope was 0.8387.
